com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class AIGraphTracker

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AIGraphTracker

  • public final class AIGraphTracker
extends java.lang.Object
    Reports graph-level events for a single invocation of an AgentGraphDefinition.

    An AIGraphTracker is obtained from an enabled graph definition via AgentGraphDefinition.createTracker(), or reconstructed from a resumption token via LDAIClient.createGraphTracker(String, LDContext).

    Graph-level methods (invocation, duration, tokens, path) are at-most-once: a second call on the same tracker is silently dropped. Edge-level methods (redirect, handoff) are multi-fire — each call records a distinct event.

    Implementations are thread-safe.

    • Method Detail

      • trackInvocationSuccess

        public void trackInvocationSuccess()
        Records that the graph invocation succeeded.

        At-most-once and mutually exclusive with trackInvocationFailure(): whichever is called first wins.

      • trackInvocationFailure

        public void trackInvocationFailure()
        Records that the graph invocation failed.

        At-most-once and mutually exclusive with trackInvocationSuccess(): whichever is called first wins.

      • trackDuration

        public void trackDuration(double durationMs)
        Records the total wall-clock duration of the graph invocation.

        At-most-once: subsequent calls on the same tracker are silently dropped. Non-finite values (Double.NaN, positive/negative infinity) are ignored without consuming the at-most-once slot.

        Parameters:
        durationMs - the duration in milliseconds; must be finite

      • trackTotalTokens

        public void trackTotalTokens(LDAITrackingTypes.TokenUsage tokens)
        Records the total token usage for the graph invocation.

        At-most-once: subsequent calls are silently dropped.

        Parameters:
        tokens - the token usage; ignored if null

      • trackPath

        public void trackPath(java.util.List<java.lang.String> path)
        Records the ordered path of node keys visited during the graph invocation.

        At-most-once: subsequent calls on the same tracker are silently dropped.

        Parameters:
        path - the ordered list of node keys; ignored if null or empty

      • trackRedirect

        public void trackRedirect(java.lang.String sourceKey,
                          java.lang.String redirectedTarget)
        Records a redirect event, where the graph transitioned from one node to a different target than the edge originally specified.

        Multi-fire: every call emits an event.

        Parameters:
        sourceKey - the key of the source node
        redirectedTarget - the key of the node that was actually used

      • getSummary

      • getResumptionToken

        public java.lang.String getResumptionToken()
        Returns the resumption token for this graph run.

        The token encodes the run identity and can be passed to LDAIClient.createGraphTracker(String, LDContext) to reconstruct the tracker across requests.

        Returns:
        the resumption token; never null
